column1: # Example-model proof policy. This file is enforced by tests/cli/examples.rs.
# Tier 0 = offline generation, apply, and idempotence; required for every model on every run.
# Tier 1 = a real JDK and the named build tool compile and execute the generated tests.
# Tier 2 = Tier 1 plus real service/container integration tests (and images where the gate says so).
# `default-if-available` means the test is in the ordinary suite and reports a skip when its declared toolchain is absent.
